description: Replace runtime-demand latent executable discovery that reconstructs local callable targets from callable type/materialization with upstream callable-flow facts. The closure expansion should request canonical activation keys from proven producer target/capture/surface facts, not from callable_value_clauses plus template fallback unless the callable is truly opaque external evidence. Tests must cover escaped lambdas, opaque callable arguments, Enumerable suspend reducers, and direct-only reducers. Remove or narrow the type-derived path so a compiler-owned local callable cannot mint an executable from type-only evidence.
title: Transport authority: derive latent callable executables from callable-flow facts
